resources.string: NASA/JPL predictions cover a limited date range; they are not live telemetry.
Proxima b uses its unresolved host-star direction. Distance refers to the stellar system; no measured surface, atmosphere or three-dimensional orbital position is available.
M87* uses the direction of the M87 nucleus. Distance and mass are approximate reference values; the image is a radio reconstruction.
Earth-orbiting objects require recent orbital elements. Positions outside their validity period are unavailable.
